# `company.payroll_drafts`

PRIVATE paycheck drafts. Readable only with payroll.read; no employee-read joins.

Database: `company`.

| Column | SQL type | Nullable | Default | Key | Indexes | References | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | VARCHAR(26) | no | — | primary key 1 | — | — | Stable paycheck draft ULID. |
| `employee_id` | VARCHAR(26) | no | — | — | ix_payroll_draft_employee_date | employees.id | Existing employee identity. |
| `version` | INTEGER | no | — | — | — | — | Optimistic draft version. |
| `state` | VARCHAR(16) | no | — | — | — | — | draft or prepared; neither posts. |
| `currency` | VARCHAR(3) | no | — | — | — | — | USD only in this increment. |
| `pay_date` | VARCHAR(10) | yes | — | — | ix_payroll_draft_employee_date | — | Actual pay date, null when not yet known. |
| `payload` | TEXT | no | — | — | — | — | PRIVATE JSON: exact earning and fixed-item inputs, dates and confirmation. |
| `calculation` | TEXT | yes | — | — | — | — | PRIVATE JSON: last calculated cents and arithmetic trace; null after editing. |
| `settings_version` | INTEGER | no | — | — | — | — | Captured settings version; prepare revalidates accounts. |
| `created_at` | VARCHAR(32) | no | — | — | — | — | UTC creation time. |
| `updated_at` | VARCHAR(32) | no | — | — | — | — | UTC last-write time. |
